jp: Added contextual '?' guide triggers to major screens and key popups.
Added section-based guided flows for Frame Data View, Combo Table, Input section, and Advanced Search.
Added dedicated workflow guides for Import, Export, and Import Notation handling.
Added focused guide flow for Hotkey Customize and input mapping.
Reused the existing tutorial overlay so guided help is consistent with startup onboarding.
Extended the tutorial system to support named flows instead of a single fixed slide sequence.
Added delegated data-tutorial-flow trigger handling so new guides can be wired without extra JS listeners.
Added contextual guide entry points inside major modals (Import Target, XLSX Mapping, Notation Manager, Hotkey Customize).
Added shared '?' trigger styling for dark/light themes and inline/modal placements.
Bumped current app/update version to v1.0.2 while preserving v1.0.1 notes.

jp: Improved startup performance.
The tool now remembers the character and control mode you were using.
Adjusted the autosave interval.
Added automatic backups before imports and other major changes.
Added restore points so data can be recovered from multiple backup snapshots.
Added an import notation dictionary with JP/EN alias normalization and user-defined entries.
Added XLSX column mapping import to handle non-standard sheets more reliably.
Control mode is now applied automatically based on your current mode (also applied to existing saved combos).
The combo table now shows only combos for the selected control mode.
Added command validation and control-mode mismatch warnings.
Added automatic Drive Gauge efficiency calculation (damage / drive gauge spent [negative value]) from entered values.
Unified changelog and roadmap under Information, and added a version-diff update popup.
Included additional UI refinements (version display, header height, etc.).

jp: Lab Monster SF6 の初回リリース。
フレームデータ閲覧、コンボ編集、基本的な入出力機能を実装。
en: Initial release of Lab Monster SF6.
Included frame-data viewer, combo editor, and baseline import/export workflow.

jp.title: Classic/Modern 間の変換補助
jp.notes: コマンド/ボタン変換と不可ルート判定の補助機能を段階実装。

jp.title: 自動計算（CAダメージ系）
jp.notes: SA3時の体力25%以下想定値（通常(CA)/C(CA)/PC(CA)）の補助計算を検討。

jp.title: UI改善（ツールチップ/詳細検索/小画面）
jp.notes: 項目説明の明確化、検索UI整理、狭幅時の視認性改善。

jp.title: 継続的なパフォーマンス最適化
jp.notes: 起動、検索/並び替え、大規模データ表示の処理を改善。

jp.title: コンボ品質の分析レポート
jp.notes: 品質指標の定義が必要で、実装コストが高いため長期検討。

jp.title: コンボ自動生成
jp.notes: データ整備と検証コストが非常に高く、実現性を継続検討。

jp.title: モバイル版（タブレット含む）
jp.notes: UI再設計が必要なため、優先度は低め。

en.title: Classic/Modern conversion assist
en.notes: Phase in command/button conversion assistance and impossible-route hints.

en.title: Auto-calculation (CA damage fields)
en.notes: Plan assist calculations for SA3 low-health values (Normal(CA)/C(CA)/PC(CA)).

en.title: UI polish (tooltips/advanced search/small screens)
en.notes: Clarify field guidance, reorganize search UI, and improve compact-window readability.

en.title: Continuous performance optimization
en.notes: Keep improving startup, search/sort, and large-table rendering performance.

en.title: Combo quality analytics
en.notes: Needs a reliable quality metric; high implementation complexity.

en.title: Automatic combo generation
en.notes: Very high data/validation cost; feasibility under review.

en.title: Mobile/tablet build
en.notes: Requires substantial UI redesign; low near-term priority.
